title: Sonic Battle
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 2188 (addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)
gbaverify naming-buster run (24000 frames): values changed with play: falls1 0>0>0>0>1>4, energy 0>0>0>1>22>1, p1 2>6>0>3>2>2

widgets.text:
Battle Mode / Story: 1-on-1 or 4-player arena fights
Each fighter has health; KO = point (the match sets points or KO count)
Ichikoro (one-hit KO) gauge fills as you take/give hits

rows: Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, Amy, Cream, Rouge, Shadow, Chaos, E-102 Gamma, Emerl and more
win skill points in fights and from the skill card shop
Shot, Power, Set, plus ground/air combos

widgets.text:
Edit Emerl's moves in the Customize menu (Skill Square)
Skill points (sp) cap how many skills he can hold

Specials come in three types: Shot, Power and Set (trap)
Before a round you choose which type to guard: that type can't hurt you, but you can't use it

rows: your next special KOs in one hit

widgets.text: Read the opponent's habits: guard the type they use most

rows: Emerald Beach, Tails' Lab, Chao Ruins, Battle Highway, Club Rouge, Amy's Room, Library, Metal Depot, Holy Summit, Colosseum, Green Hill

widgets.text:
The story moves between arena stages around the city and its outskirts
Each episode shows a map; walk to a marked spot to start the next scene or fight
Story mode has chapters per character (Sonic, Tails, Rouge, Knuckles, Amy, Cream, Shadow, E-102, Chaos, Emerl)

rows: copy moves from fighters after battles

widgets.text: Rings come from story battles and training

Over 300 skill cards to collect for Emerl
Each character's moves can be learned
Rare cards come from tougher fights

Story mode episodes unlock new characters one by one
Clear each episode to unlock the next fighter
Final chapter after all episodes (Emerl's story)

notes: challenge ranks: 3 bytes per character (Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, Shadow, Rouge, Amy, Cream, E-102, Chaos), raw rank values; player HP/energy are player 1
